# Triage
Owner: /root; 2026-09-22; implementation / behavior / local.
Source: AK requested issue creation and implementation. Issue #20 created at https://github.com/hwanjjang/kis-hl-trading-system/issues/20 . Initial worktree was clean. No commit, push, PR, merge, deployment or live order execution authorized. Base recorded in base.txt. Existing provider is local trailing with native fixed SL. All behavior work requires tests, smoke and an independent fresh-context verifier.

# Intent: Hyperliquid Native Trailing
Owner: /root. Authority: AK's 2026-09-22 issue + implementation request. Endpoint: local.
Problem: documented exchange trailing support is not integrated. Desired outcome: opt-in exchange trailing with explicit continuous-mark semantics and conservative reconciliation.
AC1: distinguish documented native functionality, available adapter and actual account-scoped readback.
AC2: prepare/submit evidenced trailingStop actions with dry-run default and eligibility guards; reuse ordinary orderStatus/cancel by native ID.
AC3: preserve native fixed SL for partial entries; opt-in trailing after entry terminality and full SL coverage; persist before send; unknown ou

# Investigation
Read 2026-09-22. Official order-types page lists continuous mark-based perp trailing with quote/percentage retracement. Public exchange docs and official Python SDK lack a dedicated helper.
Official app config-DWLPMyx3.js ace() constructs ordered action: type=trailingStop, asset, isBuy, sz (decimal string), reduceOnly, retracement={pct:"5.0000%"} or {px:"..."}, activationPx=null/string. mce() sends through I6/Uoe to /exchange; ws() signs the standard L1 Agent payload with optional expiresAfter. No cloid in this observed action. The app tests status=err; it does not prove an oid response contract. Unrecognized success must remain unknown.
App bM order schema contains oid, coin

# Specification
Plan gains trailing_provider=local|native (default local); native restricted to catalogued Hyperliquid perps. Local policy unchanged. Native management freezes ATR quote distance, activation immediately; fixed entry SL retained independently. Low-level method supports protective buy/sell, quote or percent retracement, optional activation; always reduceOnly. Reject nonfinite/invalid values, unsupported assets, stale verification, invalid precision, missing credentials and invalid environment before signed I/O.
Persist a trailing attempt before a single transmission after terminal entry and verified full fixed-SL coverage. Read trailing only by acknowledged native oid. Missing
